derivedInputs.level: Character level, or the proficiency-equivalent level of a monster (1..20).
derivedInputs.exhaustion: Exhaustion level (0..6); each level is a -2 penalty on d20 tests (attack rolls, ability checks incl. initiative, saving throws) and -5 ft of speed. Never applied to passive scores or the spell save DC; level 6 is death.
derivedInputs.speed_base: Walking speed in feet before exhaustion (species speed, e.g. 30).
derivedInputs.initiative_prof: 1 when the actor adds its proficiency bonus to initiative (Alert feat), otherwise 0.
derivedInputs.save_<ability>_prof: Saving throw proficiency multiplier per ability (0 or 1).
derivedInputs.skill_<skill>_prof: Skill proficiency multiplier per skill (0, 0.5, 1 or 2).
derivedInputs.armor_worn: 1 when body armor (or natural armor) is worn, otherwise 0.
derivedInputs.armor_base: Base AC of the worn armor, or the stat-block AC for natural armor.
derivedInputs.armor_dex_applies: 1 when the worn armor adds the Dexterity modifier, 0 for heavy or natural armor.
derivedInputs.armor_max_dex: Dexterity modifier cap of the worn armor (2 for medium, 100 for light).
derivedInputs.shield_bonus: AC bonus of the wielded shield (0 when none).
derivedInputs.unarmored_defense_con: 1 when the actor has Barbarian Unarmored Defense (10 + DEX + CON).
derivedInputs.unarmored_defense_wis: 1 when the actor has Monk Unarmored Defense (10 + DEX + WIS, no shield).
derivedInputs.spell_ability_<ability>: 1 for the spellcasting ability, 0 for every other ability.

derivedDAG.spellcasting_mod: spell_ability_str * str_mod + spell_ability_dex * dex_mod + spell_ability_con * con_mod + spell_ability_int * int_mod + spell_ability_wis * wis_mod + spell_ability_cha * cha_mod
